name: Poseidoness
source:
The Queen over the Northern Sea. Proud of her physical and magical abilities, she is even stronger than the Kraken Queen of the Southern Seas. Though she is strict, she holds no cruelty or malice. Ruling over the northern half of the seas, she metes out suitable punishments to those that disturb the peace.

Though she’s able to live on fish and seaweed, she enjoys the taste of human semen. On the occasions when she can enjoy some, she skillfully uses her tentacles to squeeze it out. She does not attack men, however. Her milking is reserved for criminals of the sea, and those who challenge her and lose.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
